_readme: Use these words for Noxium's own features in every translated page, so the same thing always has the same name. The app's own strings win: every term with an "_app" key is copied from the Noxium app's string catalog (milan458/darkroom, App/Localizable.xcstrings; "_app" is the English source key), checked on 13 November 2026 at app commit f4a8dba. When the app changes a string, update this file first, then the facts and UI strings in i18n/<lang>.json, then the pages. The website adds spaces between Latin and CJK text ("Noxium に送信"); the app doesn't. That spacing is the only intended difference. These words name Noxium's features. Generic phrases for the app category ("photo vault apps") in titles and keywords may follow what people search in that market. Apple's feature names (Hidden album, Photos' Recently Deleted, Settings paths, App Store privacy labels) are never taken from here: copy them from support.apple.com/<locale> and the localized App Store page each time. The app ships 15 languages besides English; the website uses 8 of them. The other 7 (ar, nl, hi, pl, ru, tr, zh-hans) have app strings ready when the website adds them.

vault._app: Vaults / This vault / Restore your vault
vault._note: es: the app says “caja fuerte”, shortened to “caja” in compounds (caja señuelo, caja compartida, caja principal). ko: not 보관함, which is Apple’s name for the Photos Library.

photo vault._source: App Store listing names (AppStore/listing/metadata/*/name.txt): “Privater Foto-Tresor”, “Coffre photo privé”, “Caja fuerte de fotos” (es-ES), “Cofre de Fotos Privado”, “Cassaforte per foto”, “写真と動画の秘密保管庫”, “사진 비밀 금고”. The zh-Hant listing name says “私密相簿保險箱”, but the app itself says 保險庫, so 照片保險庫 follows the app.

5×5 plate of bolts._note: Website wording only: the app’s screens never name the plate or the bolts (they say “pattern”, and VoiceOver says “Pattern grid”). Keep it to descriptions of the lock screen.

emergency erase._note: Short form, cut from the app’s “emergency erase pattern”. Prefer the full name when it fits.

album pattern._app: Album pattern / Album with its own pattern

custom app icons.ja: カスタム App アイコン

iPhone and iPad sync.ja: iPhone と iPad の同期

Recently Deleted (in Noxium)._note: Noxium’s own bin. For Apple Photos’ album, take the name from support.apple.com/<locale>.

Data Not Collected (App Store label)._verify: de, es, pt-br, it, ja, ko checked on Noxium's own localized App Store page and zh-hans on another app's China store page, 12 November 2026. fr not checked: Noxium isn't sold in the French store.
